utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the 23rd. Have we got everybody on?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, morning. The heating in the portakabin has apparently decided it's spring already. Absolutely Baltic in here.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: That's why you've got the coat zipped up to your eyebrows, then.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Exactly. Just having a moan, before anyone puts it on a list.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Morning. Am I coming through all right? Teams has picked a different microphone again.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, you're clear.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Louder than the rest of us, if anything.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, let's get into it. A few things to agree this morning.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Just before that, already swapped the filter on the Stretch Wrapper yesterday. That's done.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Ah, lovely. I wasn't sure whether that had actually happened.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, all sorted yesterday. Nothing needed on that today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers. Whitty, can you send the shift handover report round by the 28th? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, so, the report itself? We're not talking about a new format as well?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No, just send the shift handover report round. No redesign.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Fine, I'll send it round by the 28th. Understood, important rather than urgent.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: You looked worried there. Nearly had to choose a font.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: That's how it starts, mate. Then suddenly you've got twelve tabs.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie, can you sort the training records for the new starters today? Low priority.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Today, yeah? Just checking because you said low priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yeah, still today. Low priority within today, not one to push everything else out for.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Got you. I'll sort the training records for the new starters today.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, the records side can look tiny until you actually open it.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Don't say that. I'm choosing to remain optimistic.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tommo, can you run the monthly fire alarm test by Wednesday? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yep, I'll run the monthly fire alarm test by Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Monthly already? Feels like February's only just started.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I know. But Wednesday's the limit on that one, even though it's not an emergency.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Understood. It won't get lost at the bottom.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: February cheats. Same amount of stuff, fewer days.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Doesn't seem to mean fewer meetings, though.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: While I've got the mic, I'll update the risk assessment for work on the Atlas tomorrow. Normal priority for that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Tommo. Tomorrow, normal priority, agreed.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Mm, the wording on those matters. Everyone thinks they mean the same thing until they're stood in front of it.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, exactly. Needs to make sense to the person doing the work, not just the person reading it at a desk.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Especially when it's a wall of text. You lose the actual risk in all the words.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. There's one more, and this is the one that comes first.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Tom, can you replace the seals on the GT2 inlet valve today at 2pm? Top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Sorry, you broke up just on the time. Today at two?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Today at 2pm, yes. Replace the seals on the GT2 inlet valve. Top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, that one's the main concern from the plant side.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Right, I've got you now. I'll replace the seals on the GT2 inlet valve today at 2pm. That's my top priority.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, makes sense to put that ahead of the paperwork.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. The other dates we've agreed still stand, but that gets first call.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Definitely not going to argue that training records outrank that.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Good, because I've only got the one pair of hands, despite popular belief.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: You were clear that time, by the way. Think it was just a little Teams wobble.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Same here. Lost half a second, then it came back.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Anything unclear about what we've agreed?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: No, all clear from me.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Same. Nothing else from production this morning.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Thanks, everyone. I'll let you get back to it.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Cheers, all.
